import socket,json,re
o={"http_connect_proxy":True,"authentication_schemes":[]}
try:
 s=socket.create_connection(("104.165.1.52",6637),timeout=5);s.settimeout(4)
 s.sendall(b"CONNECT api.telegram.org:443 HTTP/1.1\r\nHost: api.telegram.org:443\r\nConnection: close\r\n\r\n")
 b=b""
 while b"\r\n\r\n" not in b and len(b)<6000:
  part=s.recv(700)
  if not part:break
  b+=part
 headers=b.decode("latin1","replace").split("\r\n")
 o["status"]=headers[0][:100]
 schemes=[]
 for line in headers[1:]:
  if line.lower().startswith("proxy-authenticate:"):
   v=line.split(":",1)[1].strip()
   scheme=v.split(" ",1)[0].strip()
   if scheme.lower() in ("basic","digest","negotiate","ntlm"):schemes.append(scheme)
 o["authentication_schemes"]=schemes
except Exception as e:o["error_type"]=type(e).__name__
finally:
 try:s.close()
 except:pass
print(json.dumps(o,ensure_ascii=True))
